Terms and Conditions:
1. Period of Engagement:
. The engagement shall initially be for a period of up to 28-02-2027.
. The engagement may be renewed on a yearly basis subject to satisfactory performance,
administrative requirement and approval of the competent authority.
. The engagement of Additional lnspector shall be co-terminus with the ioining of a regular
tnspector, B,C.W. & T.D. against the notified vacancies, and no claim for continuation or regular
engagement shall arise thereafter.
2. Nature of Engagement:
. The engagement shall be purely contractual in nature.
. The selected candidate shall not have any claim for regular appointment or permanent absorption
under the Government of West Bengal by virtue of such engagement.
. The place of posting shall be decided based on the merit position of the candidate and the
preference exercised by the candidate.
3. Agreement:
r The selected candidate shall execute an agreement with the appointing authority before joining the
assignment.
. The agreement shall specify the terms and conditions governing the contractual engagement.
4. Participation in Walk-in-lnterview:
. Candidates shall appear personally before the Recruitment Committee on the scheduled date and
time at the venue mentioned in the notice.
. Candidates reporting after the scheduled reporting time may not be allowed to participate in the
interview.
5. Documents to be Produced:
Candidates shall bring self-attested copies of the following documents along with the original documents
for verification:
. Pension Payment Order (P,P.O.).
. Proof of Date of Birth/Age.
. Aadhaar Card.
. EPIC (Voter ldentity Card).
. Proof of last post held at the time of retirement
. Any other document supporting eligibility.

5. General lnstructions:
r The prescribed application format must be duly filled in and submitted at the time of the Walk-in-
lnterview.
o Incomplete application forms or non-production of required documents may lead to disqualification.
. Preference may be given to candidates having experience in implementation of schemes and
programmes under the Backward Classes Welfare & Tribal Development Department.
. The Recruitment Committee reserves the right to accept or reject any candidature without assigning
any reason.
e Mere participation in the Walk-in-lnterview does not confer any right upon the candidate for
selection or engagement.
. No TA/DA shall be admissible for attending the Walk-in-lnterview.
. The Recruitment Committee reserves the right to cancel, postpone, or modify the recruitment
process at any stage without assigning any reason
